title: גלריית תמונות
source: live page, read 23.11.2026 (content/pages/gallery.md, snapshot 15.11.2026: not modified since)
notes: The live page: the H1, then one long run of 119 photos and nothing else (no heading or text between them; 39 of the places have a caption line under the photo). From place 56 on it shows many of the photos again: 88 different media, 31 of them shown twice (every repeat at place 56 or later). Here one grid (products: 3 columns, captions on), each photo once at its first place in the live order: 86 photos. Two more pairs are one photo under two media and are used once too: 578 and 553 (the same file uploaded twice; live-578 at the photo's first place, 92 of the run) and 523 and 183 (one photo in two sizes, at places 25, 46, 66 and 71; live-183, the larger file and the one the live page captions, at the photo's first place, 25). A repeat has the same caption as its first place, so no caption is lost. The captions are live's, under 29 photos (media → caption, for media.json); a photo without one needs "caption": "" there, or the builder shows its alt as a caption. Every live photo is kept (the user, 23.11: blur the faces, remove nothing); the faces are blurred in the media files, not here. live-523 and live-553 are left unused.
